channel.title: Basil Saji Mathew: guides on FiveM, Lua and server security
channel.description: Guides on FiveM Lua, backups and server security.

item.title: How to Block RDP Brute-Force Attacks on Windows Server
item.description: Practical steps to detect and stop RDP password-guessing attacks on Windows: Event ID 4625, account lockout, NLA, firewall rules and automated blocking.

item.title: Automate MySQL Backups for a FiveM Server (ESX, QBCore, Qbox)
item.description: A practical guide to automatic MySQL backups for FiveM servers: mysqldump, compression, retention, offsite copies, restore tests and Discord alerts.

item.title: Fail2ban for Windows? RDP and SSH Protection Options Compared
item.description: Fail2ban only runs on Linux. Here is how to get the same brute-force protection for Windows RDP and Linux SSH, with the trade-offs of each approach.

item.title: How to Optimize FiveM Lua Scripts: Reaching 0.00ms Idle
item.description: Practical Lua performance tips for FiveM: avoid Wait(0) loops, use distance-based waits, cache natives, use zones and keep database calls off the hot path.
